parole.significato: the letter alpha (first letter of the Greek alphabet)
parole.testo: Ultimately from Ancient Greek ἄλφα (álpha), of Semitic origin. Doublet of alef.

parole.significato: beta (second letter of the Greek alphabet and certain descended alphabets)
parole.testo: Ultimately from Ancient Greek βῆτα (bêta), of Semitic origin. Doublet of beth.

parole.significato: canon (set of representative or pre-eminent literary works)
parole.testo: From Ancient Greek κανών (kanṓn, “measuring rod, standard”), akin to κάννα (kánna, “reed”), perhaps from Semitic (compare Hebrew קנה (qaneh, “reed”)).
